Name: Em's Sheep
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
Nine colour options for the sheep. Making them softer and more realistic-looking
Including the sheep, sheared sheep, baby sheep and Marnie's shop icon
Available for Content Patcher and Alternative textures
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]

The different types are:
Welsh (white and brown)
Coburg
Zwartbles
Hampshire (white and black)
Dutch
Balwen
Gute
Corriedale

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1HQ4bKW/CP.png[/img]﻿

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's Sheep CP"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!

When buying a sheep from Marnie, the type gets randomised and can be any of the nine options
If you rather choose which colour you get, you can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar
[/url]
Alternatively, you can choose ﻿"Em's Sheep CP Config"
This allows you to choose one type for your farm with a [i]config.json[/i]

The default sheep is the [color=#efefef]Welsh[/color]. To choose a different type:
Open the [i]config.json[/i] in the Sheep mod folder
Replace "﻿[color=#e69138]Welsh[/color]" with the name of the type you like
The choice you make also affects Marnie's shop icon
Save and close the folder again, and you're all set!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/MGb2cDyd/Patchnotes.png[/img]

[i]Update 1.1 Solved the missing walking animation of the gute lamb
Update 1.2 Included update keys and minor AT script fixes
Update 1.3 Both files can now be installed side by side
Update 1.4 Three new sheep and changes to old sprites. CP now allows multiple types. Compatible with livestock bazaar.[/i]
